Title: AI CLI service: the four containments as refusals, plus the session launch
CodeSymbol: ai_cli_service.assert_service_account; ai_cli_service.assert_safe_template; ai_cli_service.resolve_bind; ai_cli_service.request_scratch; ai_cli_service.handle_ask; setup-ai-cli.sh
Detail: Each acceptance property is a REFUSAL in code rather than a line in a unit file: assert_service_account rejects hub/root, a privileged group and a sudoers mention; assert_safe_template rejects any --dangerously-* prefix, --bare, and a missing or wrong-valued family read-only token, and runs at startup AND at every launch because the registry can be edited on the box; resolve_bind rejects the wildcard by name and everything outside loopback and 172.16/12, before the socket exists; request_scratch gives one mkdtemp 0700 directory per request and removes it on every exit path. Registry loading, the per-row cooldown and the prompt-on-stdin/--output-last-message session decisions reuse ai-template's structure (its IF-045/IF-064) and none of its flags. setup-ai-cli.sh re-checks the account's privilege on every boot.
